# Cora — The AI Workspace for Ambitious Founders
> Operating Entity: Claraverse (https://heycora.in)
> Main App: https://app.heycora.in/workspace

## Product Overview
Cora is an AI-powered operating system for founders, digital agencies, and solo builders.
It unifies multi-model AI agents (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini, Groq), client pipeline funnels, document signing, and GST-compliant invoicing under a single command center.

## Pricing Specifications
- Free Forever Plan: $0 / forever. 1,000 AI Agent Runs/mo, Core Models (Gemini & GPT-4o mini), Document Vault, Unlimited Client Funnels.
- India Only Plan: ₹499 / mo (Billed annually at ₹4,999 / year). 2,500 AI Agent Runs/mo, All Pro Features, UPI & RuPay Direct Billing, Full GST Invoicing (B2B).
- Starter Plan: $9 / mo ($90 / year). 5,000 AI Agent Runs/mo, Claude 3.5 Sonnet Access, Custom Workspace Domain.
- Pro Studio Plan: $19 / mo ($190 / year). 10,000 AI Agent Runs/mo, All Frontier Models (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini), 3 Team Seats, GST Invoicing.
- Scale & Agency Plan: $39 / mo ($390 / year). Unlimited AI Agent Executions, 10 Team Seats, Custom Personas, 99.9% SLA.
